lore.alloyed.steel_fishing_rod: A sturdy fishing rod reinforced with Steel. It can be upgraded to Infernite at a Smithing Table.
lore.alloyed.bronze_ingot: An alloy of Copper and Zinc forged with Nether Dust. Used for kinetic machinery, and as the next tier of tools after Copper.
lore.alloyed.bronze_nugget: A small piece of Bronze that can be combined into an ingot.
lore.alloyed.bronze_sheet: Bronze flattened with a Mechanical Press.
lore.alloyed.bronze_block: A solid block of Bronze. It weathers over time like Copper unless waxed.
lore.alloyed.bronze_bell: A bell cast from Bronze. It rings when struck or powered.
lore.alloyed.steel_ingot: A very sturdy alloy forged from Iron, Coal, and a Fire Charge. Steel tools can mine Gold, Diamond, and Flux ores.
lore.alloyed.steel_nugget: A small piece of Steel that can be combined into an ingot.
lore.alloyed.steel_sheet: Steel flattened with a Mechanical Press.
lore.alloyed.steel_sheet_metal: A decorative block of Steel sheeting.
lore.alloyed.steel_scaffolding: Steel scaffolding that can be climbed and traversed like Bamboo Scaffolding.
lore.alloyed.steel_casing: A Steel-plated casing used to make heavy-duty kinetic components.
lore.alloyed.steel_encased_large_cogwhee: A Large Cogwheel encased in Steel.
lore.alloyed.steel_pickaxe: A sturdy Steel pickaxe. It can mine Gold, Diamond, and Flux.
lore.alloyed.steel_horse_armor: Steel armor that protects a Horse from damage.
